title: Touhou Bunkachou ~ Shoot the Bullet - Wind Circulation ~ Wind Tour
description:
The cheerful first photo theme from the 9.5th Touhou game, Shoot the Bullet.

This song is probably best suited for early stages where things are breezy and you're jumping right into the game. It also holds a special place in my heart since StB was the first Touhou I played.
